# --- The last line of a buffer, and whether there is one after a trailing newline.
#
# IntelliJ's document has a line after a trailing `\n` that you can put a caret on; this host counts
# lines by counting newlines, so it does not. Everything below is that one difference: `cc` and `dd`
# on the last line take the wrong range, `S` leaves an extra line behind, and `j` and `G` stop one
# line short of where Vim puts them. The largest single finding in the corpus.
src/test/java/org/jetbrains/plugins/ideavim/action/change/change/ChangeLineActionTest.kt:test on last line
src/test/java/org/jetbrains/plugins/ideavim/action/change/change/ChangeLineActionTest.kt:test on last line with new line with S
src/test/java/org/jetbrains/plugins/ideavim/action/change/change/ChangeLineActionTest.kt:test on last line with new line with cc
src/test/java/org/jetbrains/plugins/ideavim/action/change/change/ChangeLineActionTest.kt:test on very last line with new line with S2
src/test/java/org/jetbrains/plugins/ideavim/action/change/delete/DeleteMotionActionTest.kt:test delete on last line
src/test/java/org/jetbrains/plugins/ideavim/action/motion/updown/MotionDownActionTest.kt:test motion to the last empty line
src/test/java/org/jetbrains/plugins/ideavim/action/motion/updown/MotionGotoLineLastActionTest.kt:test with last empty line

# --- Replace mode.
#
# `R` past the end of a line should append rather than overwrite what follows, and backspace in
# replace mode should put back the character that was overwritten. The mask this host keeps is
# wrong in both directions. Nothing in this module had ever pressed `R` twice.
src/test/java/org/jetbrains/plugins/ideavim/action/change/change/ChangeReplaceActionTest.kt:test replace mode past the end of the line appends instead of replacing the next line
src/test/java/org/jetbrains/plugins/ideavim/action/change/insert/InsertBackspaceActionTest.kt:test replace mode backspace restores a character replaced at the start of the line
src/test/java/org/jetbrains/plugins/ideavim/action/change/insert/InsertBackspaceActionTest.kt:test replace mode backspace restores a character replaced away from the start of the line

# --- Reindenting, which is a VS Code command and therefore asynchronous.
